summary: Tolerate up to twice main in relative perf-load latency and CPU comparisons while keeping every absolute budget and correctness check.

replay.detail: Performance test policy only; no projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No schema, migration or stored-data changes.

rules.detail: No writer, checkpoint, retention or authority changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing workload, reports, baseline provenance and migration regimes are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service or runner deployment is introduced.

manual.detail: No manual step or workflow rerun is introduced.

recovery.detail: Reverting this test policy restores the prior 1.2x relative threshold; historical failures remain recorded.
